answer: To enforce Sybil resistance, validators must lock staking collateral on a randomized beacon chain where identity is bound by zero-knowledge verifiable delays. If a coalition attempts identity multiplication, a subgame-perfect slashing matrix extracts their entire deposit, rendering the expected attack utility strictly negative. This framework models resource allocation as a dynamic marble-distribution game. Because agents who harbor adversarial intents face infinite opportunity costs, the system converges to a unique, highly stable Nash equilibrium.
